entries.title: Genesis 40:1
segments: And after these things it happened that the cupbearer of the king of Egypt, and his baker, had offended their lord the king of Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 40:2
segments: And Pharaoh was angry against two of his eunuchs, against the chief of the cupbearers and against the chief of the bakers.

entries.title: Genesis 40:3
segments: And he put them under guard in the house of the chief of the executioners, into the prison, the place where Joseph [was] bound.

entries.title: Genesis 40:4
segments: And the chief of the executioners charged Joseph with them, and he served them. And they continued for a time under guard.

entries.title: Genesis 40:5
segments: And they dreamed a dream, both of them, each man his dream in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who [were] bound in the prison.

entries.title: Genesis 40:6
segments: And Joseph came in to them in the morning, and looked upon them, and behold, they [were] sad.

entries.title: Genesis 40:7
segments: And he asked Pharaoh's eunuchs who [were] with him under guard in his lord's house, saying, Why are your faces sad today?

entries.title: Genesis 40:8
segments: And they said to him, We have dreamed a dream, and [there is] no interpreter of it. And Joseph said to them, Do not interpretations [belong] to God? Now tell it to me.

entries.title: Genesis 40:9
segments: And the chief cupbearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, In my dream, behold, a vine [was] before me.

entries.title: Genesis 40:10
segments: And in the vine [were] three branches. And it was as if it budded, and its blossom shot up. And the clusters of it brought forth ripe grapes.

entries.title: Genesis 40:11
segments: And Pharaoh's cup [was] in my hand. And I took the grapes and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

entries.title: Genesis 40:12
segments: And Joseph said to him, This [is] the interpretation of it. The three branches are three days.

entries.title: Genesis 40:13
segments: Yet within three days Pharaoh shall lift up your head and restore you to your place. And you shall deliver Pharaoh's cup into his hand, just as you did when you were his cupbearer.

entries.title: Genesis 40:14
segments: But remember me when it is well with you, and please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

entries.title: Genesis 40:15
segments: For indeed I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also have I done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.

entries.title: Genesis 40:16
segments: When the chief baker saw the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, I also [saw] in my dream, and three baskets of white bread [were] on my head.

entries.title: Genesis 40:17
segments: And in the top basket [were] all kinds of baked foods for Pharaoh. And the birds ate them out of the basket upon my head.

entries.title: Genesis 40:18
segments: And Joseph answered and said, This [is] the interpretation of it. The three baskets are three days.

entries.title: Genesis 40:19
segments: Yet within three days Pharaoh shall lift up your head from off you, and shall hang you on a tree. And the birds shall eat your flesh from off you.

entries.title: Genesis 40:20
segments: And it happened on the third day, Pharaoh's birthday, that he made a feast to all his servants. And he lifted up the head of the chief cupbearer, and of the chief baker, among his servants.

entries.title: Genesis 40:21
segments: And he restored the chief cupbearer back into his cupbearer office again. And he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.

entries.title: Genesis 40:22
segments: But he hanged the chief baker, even as Joseph had interpreted to them.

entries.title: Genesis 40:23
segments: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
